enriched.title: Passado Simples e Contínuo com Vocabulário do Cotidiano
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso dos tempos verbais Simple Past e Past Continuous, com exemplos práticos em contextos diários e profissionais. Além disso, trabalha vocabulário relacionado a culinária, rotinas e negócios.

vocabulary.definition: The middle of the day, typically around 12:00 PM.
examples: We will meet at midday for lunch.
Midday is the perfect time for a short break.

vocabulary.definition: To act as if something is true when it is not.
examples: The child pretended to be a superhero.
He pretended he was not tired.

vocabulary.definition: To have a plan or purpose in mind.
examples: She intends to visit her family this weekend.
Do you intend to finish the project today?

vocabulary.definition: A black or dark brown combustible mineral substance used as fuel.
examples: Coal is used in many coal-fired ovens.
The miners extracted coal from the ground.

vocabulary.definition: As much or as many as needed.
examples: I have enough money to buy the ticket.
There’s enough food for everyone.

vocabulary.definition: Animal dung used as fertilizer for plants.
examples: Farmers often use manure to grow vegetables.
The smell of manure was strong in the fields.

vocabulary.definition: A grant of financial aid for a student to continue their education.
examples: She received a scholarship to study abroad.
The university offers several scholarships.

grammar.explanation: The Simple Past is used for completed actions in the past, while the Past Continuous describes actions that were in progress at a specific moment in the past.
rules: Use the Simple Past for actions that started and finished in the past (e.g., 'I walked to school.').
Use the Past Continuous for actions that were ongoing in the past, often interrupted by another action (e.g., 'I was walking to school when it started to rain.').
examples: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven.
The chef was preparing the signature dish when he burned his finger.
It started to hail while we were hiking through the forest.
commonMistakes: Using the Simple Past instead of the Past Continuous for ongoing actions (e.g., 'I walked to the bus when it rained' instead of 'I was walking to the bus when it rained').
Forgetting to use 'was/were' with the verb ending in -ing for the Past Continuous.

expressions.usage: Used to emphasize the duration of an action throughout the entire day.
examples: She was cleaning the house all day long.
We worked all day long to finish the project.

expressions.usage: Used to indicate a minimum amount or expectation.
examples: You should sleep at least eight hours a night.
At least we finished the task on time.

practiceQuestions.question: The students / whisper / to each other / when / the teacher / walk / into the classroom.
practiceQuestions.answer: The students were whispering to each other when the teacher walked into the classroom.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The action of whispering was ongoing (Past Continuous), interrupted by the teacher walking in (Simple Past).

practiceQuestions.question: While / the CEO / deliver / her speech / the microphone / stop / working.
practiceQuestions.answer: While the CEO was delivering her speech, the microphone stopped working.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The speech was ongoing (Past Continuous), interrupted by the microphone stopping (Simple Past).

culturalNotes: In English-speaking countries, 'scholarship' is often associated with academic achievement and financial aid for students.
Coal-fired ovens are traditional in many cultures, especially for baking pizzas and bread.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences using both the Simple Past and Past Continuous.
Learn vocabulary in context by associating words with real-life scenarios.
originalExamples: The baker dropped the tray while he was taking the fresh bread out of the oven. (O padeiro deixou cair a bandeja enquanto tirava o pão fresco do forno.)
It started to hail while we were hiking through the forest. (Começou a chover granizo enquanto caminhávamos pela floresta.)
The students were whispering to each other when the teacher walked into the classroom. (Os alunos estavam cochichando quando o professor entrou na sala.)
